narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed across the Mogollon Rim and International Border during the afternoon and moved west across southeast Arizona through the evening hours. Several storms became severe with damaging winds of 60 to 90 mph that created blowing dust and downed trees and power poles. The most extensive structural damage occurred in the Sierra Vista/Fort Huachuca and Green Valley/Sahuarita areas.
ev: Heavy rain of 2.5 in less than 1 hour at the headwaters of Tanque Verde Creek caused a 1 foot rise in water levels at Tanque Verde Loop Road, resulting in its closure.
